_comment: BENCH-02 (#58) regression-gate baseline. Values are the median ns/op across three fresh ReleaseFast runs on the reporter's shared developer workstation (2026-04-18). The CI gate in ci/bench_gate.py fails a pipeline when the current min-of-N exceeds baseline * tolerance. Tolerance is deliberately loose (30%) because intra-run jitter on shared hardware measured 11-17% on the BENCH-01 harness; a tighter gate would flap. Re-baseline with `zig build bench -Doptimize=ReleaseFast` on the same host and copy the BENCH_JSON payload values here.
units: ns/op (min-of-N, N=9 rounds of 100000 iterations each)
